dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: I don't much like spending time in places where there's nothing to do. It's like looking at a blank page in a book.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: But since you're here, maybe we can liven things up a little to make this time more meaningful.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: Like... Ooh, we could share some stories with each other before we set off again.
